title: Seasonal grounds care for a Sidney condo strata

seo.title: Sample project: Sidney strata grounds care | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: a year-round written grounds plan for a Sidney condo strata, with visit notes and one contact for council.

summary: A written, year-round grounds plan for a mid-size condo strata near Beacon Avenue.
scope: Mowing and edging on a seasonal schedule
Visit notes to the property manager
challenge: The council wanted the same standard all year and one person to call when owners had concerns.
approach: We wrote a scope that listed the tasks for each visit, with a calendar for hedge trims and spring and fall cleanups.
After each visit the property manager got a short note of what was done and anything that needed a decision.
result: Council had a written scope to review each season and a single contact for owner concerns.
